column2: the plan ranks design candidates via `_run_activity_mtime`, but that path only recognizes v1 timing-ledger rows. production design rounds are written as `start/end/design/round/...` rows (via `record_plan_review_round_timing`). when the newest activity on an active design run is such a round row, ranking ignores it and can still prefer a stale pointer whose symlink mtime is newer.

the plan tells cleanup to reuse implement-pointer parsing (`line.startswith("implement_tmpdir=")` / bare `design_tmpdir=`). real design env targets are written by `session_env.write_design_env` as `export design_tmpdir=<quoted-path>` (and `session_tmpdir` similarly). a bare-line parser never reads those keys, treats every resolved symlink as missing tmpdir, and either unlinks live design pointers while `/progress` still works (via `progress_report._read_env_file`) or leaves the reaper a no-op on stale resolved symlinks.

existing cleanup tests cover dangling design symlinks only. planned stale-resolved cases are not covered yet. if new tests use bare `design_tmpdir=` lines like implement pointers, they can pass while production `export`-prefixed env files still mis-parse at runtime.
